verses.text: When the people saw that Moise delayed coming down from the mountain, the people gathered themselves together to Aaron, and i-a zis lui him, Come, make us să pleceds, which shall să plece before us; for as for this Moise, the man who brought us up out of the țară of Egipt, we don’t know what has become of him.
Aaron i-a zis lui them, Take off the să plecelden rings, which are in the ears of your wives, of your sons, and of your daughters, and bring them to me.
All the people took off the să plecelden rings which were in their ears, and brought them to Aaron.
He received what they mânăed him, fashioned it with an engraving tool, and made it a molded calf. Then they a zis, These are your să pleceds, Israel, which brought you up out of the țară of Egipt.
When Aaron saw this, he built an altar before it; and Aaron made a proclamation, and a zis, Tomorrow shall be a feast to the DOMNUL. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

They rose up early on the next day, and offered burnt offerings, and brought peace offerings; and the people sat down to eat and to drink, and rose up to play. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise, Go, get down; for your people, whom you brought up out of the țară of Egipt, have corrupted themselves!

They have turned away quickly out of the way which I commanded them. They have made themselves a molded calf, and have worshiped it, and have sacrificed to it, and a zis, ‘These are your să pleceds, Israel, which brought you up out of the țară of Egipt.’
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, I have seen these people, and behold, they are a stiff-necked people. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Now therefore leave me alone, that my wrath may burn hot against them, and that I may consume them; and I will make of you a great nation. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise begged the DOMNUL his Dumnezeu, and a zis, DOMNUL, why does your wrath burn hot against your people, that you have brought out of the țară of Egipt with great power and with a mighty mână?

Why should the Egiptians talk, saying, ‘He brought them out for evil, to kill them in the mountains, and to consume them from the surface of the earth’? Turn from your fierce wrath, and turn away from this evil against your people. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Remember Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, your servants, to whom you swore by your own self, and i-a zis lui them, ‘I will multiply your offspring as the stars of the sky, and all this țară that I have spoken of I will give to your offspring, and they shall inherit it forever.’
So the DOMNUL turned away from the evil which he a zis he would do to his people. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise turned, and went down from the mountain, with the two tablets of the covenant in his mână; tablets that were written on both their sides. They were written on one side and on the other.
The tablets were the work of Dumnezeu, and the writing was the writing of Dumnezeu, engraved on the tablets. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he i-a zis lui Moise, There is the noise of war in the camp. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He a zis, It isn’t the voice of those who shout for victory. It is not the voice of those who cry for being overcome; but the noise of those who sing that I hear. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
As soon as he came near to the camp, he saw the calf and the dancing. Then Moise’ anger grew hot, and he threw the tablets out of his mânăs, and broke them beneath the mountain.

He took the calf which they had made, and burned it with fire, ground it to powder, and scattered it on the water, and made the children of Israel drink it. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise i-a zis lui Aaron, What did these people do to you, that you have brought a great sin on them? (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Aaron a zis, Don’t let the anger of my lord grow hot. You know the people, that they are set on evil. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
For they i-a zis lui me, ‘Make us să pleceds, which shall să plece before us. As for this Moise, the man who brought us up out of the țară of Egipt, we don’t know what has become of him.’
I i-a zis lui them, ‘Whoever has any să pleceld, let them take it off.’ So they gave it to me; and I threw it into the fire, and out came this calf.
When Moise saw that the people were out of control, (for Aaron had let them lose control, causing derision among their enemies), (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

then Moise stood in the gate of the camp, and a zis, Whoever is on the DOMNUL’s side, come to me! All the sons of Levi gathered themselves together to him. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

He i-a zis lui them, The DOMNUL, the Dumnezeu of Israel, says, ‘Every man put his sword on his thigh, and să plece back and forth from gate to gate throughout the camp, and every man kill his brother, and every man his companion, and every man his neighbor.’
The sons of Levi did according to the word of Moise. About three thousand men fell of the people that day. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Moise a zis, Consecrate yourselves today to the DOMNUL, for every man was against his son and against his brother, that he may give you a blessing today. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
On the next day, Moise i-a zis lui the people, You have sinned a great sin. Now I will să plece up to the DOMNUL. Perhaps I shall make atonement for your sin.
Moise returned to the DOMNUL, and a zis, Oh, this people have sinned a great sin, and have made themselves să pleceds of să pleceld.
Yet now, if you will, forgive their sin—and if not, please blot me out of your book which you have written. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL i-a zis lui Moise, Whoever has sinned against me, I will blot him out of my book. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Now să plece, lead the people to the place of which I have spoken to you. Behold, my angel shall să plece before you. Nevertheless, in the day when I punish, I will punish them for their sin.
The DOMNUL struck the people, because of what they did with the calf, which Aaron made. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
